rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that is very large.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sai1 gwaa1 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this especially before a noun when stressing that an object is giant-sized.

example.traditional: 我哋買咗個巨型漢堡包。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 go3 geoi6 jing4 hon3 bou2 baau1
